model.title: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL establishing a framework of measures for strengthening the Union innovation ecosystem and amending Regulation (EU) 2017/1001 (European Innovation Act)

summary.text: This proposal aims to strengthen Europe's ability to innovate by establishing a framework of supporting measures across the continent. It would also make changes to existing rules governing European trademarks and designs.
